items.summary: As Giving Tuesday approaches, a recent study led by a University of Massachusetts Amherst public policy researcher finds that communities with greater economic disadvantage typically see less private charitable giving—despite having greater needs in many cases.

items.title: Gene variant gives male malaria mosquitoes a mating edge in the heat
items.summary: Mosquitoes play a major role in spreading malaria, and understanding how they adapt to climate change is important for improving malaria prevention and control.

items.summary: Though we may fight with our siblings sometimes, for most people a sibling is a constant companion throughout childhood and often for one's entire life. items.title: Rethinking the 'girls are worse with money' myth
items.summary: New research led by Dr. Stephen Agnew from Te Whare Wānanga o Waitaha | University of Canterbury's (UC) Department of Economics and Finance is challenging one of the most persistent assumptions in education and everyday culture: that teenage girls are less financially literate than boys.
